name: Codebase Knowledge Builder
description: Agent that crawls a GitHub repository or local folder and writes a beginner-friendly tutorial explaining how the code works.
whatItDoes: The tool analyses an unfamiliar codebase, picks out its main abstractions and how they relate, and produces a multi-chapter tutorial. It helps new contributors get oriented. Output can be generated in other languages.
howItWorks: A Pocket Flow workflow fetches the files, asks an LLM to identify core concepts and their relationships, orders them into chapters and writes each one. Include and exclude patterns and a size cap control what is read. The LLM call is isolated in one utility file, with Gemini as the default.

requirements.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
requirements.description: For private repositories or to avoid rate limits

models: Gemini by default; other LLMs by editing the call utility
